mapper.select: select apt_cmplex_no, apt_cmplex_nm, bjd_cd, sido_nm, sigungu_nm, emd_nm, lat_val, lon_val, unit_cnt, bld_yr, cnsco_nm, img_file_no, rprsnt_img_file_no, heat_ty, pkg_cnt, max_floor, free_pkg_cnt, dong_cnt, dorojuso, cc_cnt from apt_complex where apt_cmplex_no = #{aptCmplexNo}
mapper.update: UPDATE APT_COMPLEX SET BJD_CD = #{bjdCd}, SIDO_NM = #{sidoNm}, SIGUNGU_NM = #{sigunguNm}, EMD_NM = #{emdNm}, LAT_VAL = #{latVal}, LON_VAL = #{lonVal}, UNIT_CNT = #{unitCnt}, BLD_YR = #{bldYr}, CNSCO_NM = #{cnscoNm}, IMG_FILE_NO = #{imgFileNo}, RPRSNT_IMG_FILE_NO = #{rprsntImgFileNo}, HEAT_TY = #{heatTy}, PKG_CNT = #{pkgCnt}, MAX_FLOOR = #{maxFloor}, FREE_PKG_CNT = #{freePkgCnt}, DONG_CNT = #{dongCnt}, DOROJUSO = #{dorojuso}, CC_CNT = #{ccCnt} WHERE APT_CMPLEX_NO = #{aptCmplexNo}
mapper.select: SELECT MO.APT_CMPLEX_NO FROM MANAGER M JOIN MGMT_OFFICE MO ON M.MGMT_OFC_NO = MO.MGMT_OFC_NO WHERE M.USER_NO = #{userNo} AND MO.USE_YN = 'Y'
